headline: Share India Securities Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Allotment of Securities - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Board of Directors of the Company vide Resolution passed through Circulation on November 04, 2026, approved the allotment of…
detail: Allotment of Securities - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Board of Directors of the Company vide Resolution passed through Circulation on November 04, 2026, approved the allotment of 44,02,000, fully paid-up equity shares of face value of Rs. 2/-each pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited.
